fact: AMI reports the National Assembly adopted on 30 January 2018 the 102-article bill on electronic transactions (electronic writing equal to paper, e-commerce provider liability, a national certification authority); the report does not say it was promulgated.
system: Projet de loi portant sur les transactions électroniques

fact: The minister told the Assembly that before this bill the law covered banking operations and some aspects of e-commerce under ordinance No. 2006-031 of 23 August 2006 on payment instruments and e-commerce operations, with implementing texts; AMI reports this on 2018-01-30.
system: Ordonnance n° 2006-031 relative aux instruments de paiement et aux opérations du commerce électronique

fact: Tech Rek reports the draft decree is made under law no. 2018-022 of 12 June 2018 on electronic exchanges.
